yt_title: Smartsheet vs Stackby: 56% less, real apps 💸 #Shorts
yt_description:
Smartsheet or Stackby? We compared Smartsheet Business with Stackby Business on databases, apps, workflows, interfaces and AI, then priced both for a team of 3.

Smartsheet Business: $684 a year ($19/seat/month × 3, billed annually).
Stackby Business: $299 a year for 3 users.
That's $385 saved every year, 56% less.

Feature by feature
• Relational database: Smartsheet Sheets + cross-sheet refs · Stackby Linked tables
• Apps & portals: Smartsheet Dashboards & forms · Stackby Interfaces & portals
• Automations: Smartsheet Workflows · Stackby 25,000 runs / month
• Live API data: Smartsheet Premium connectors · Stackby API columns & sync connectors
• AI: Smartsheet Plan-dependent · Stackby Included
• Free plan: Smartsheet No free plan · Stackby Free to start
• 3 users, billed yearly: Smartsheet $684 / year · Stackby $299 / year · Business

Stackby plans (3 users included, billed annually)
• Economy: $149/year for 3 users (7,000 records per database, 1,000 automation runs / month, interfaces, AI & API columns)
• Business: $299/year for 3 users (50,000 records per database, 25,000 automation runs / month, interfaces, AI, API columns & sync)
• Pro: $449/year for 3 users (100,000 records per database, 100,000 automation runs / month, custom domain & enterprise access)
Every plan includes AI, API columns and interfaces/portals. Business and Pro add sync connectors for Instagram, YouTube, Meta Ads and more; Pro adds enterprise access.

👉 Try Stackby free: https://stackby.com/signup

What you'll see built
• Project Portfolio

• Resource Directory
• Live Status Dashboard
